metadata.title: Rationally slice knots that are not biprojectively H-slice
metadata.abstract: We show that rationally slice knots need not be biprojectively H-slice (BPH-slice), answering a question in the study of the rational knot concordance group. Our main tool is a lattice embedding obstruction to H-sliceness in $\#^n\mathbb{CP}^2$ for knots with vanishing signature, extending work of Kjuchukova--Miller--Ray--Sakallı. We apply the obstruction to an infinite family of rationally slice knots, beginning with $8_{18}$. As additional applications, we obstruct the BPH-sliceness of a family of 2-bridge knots which is not obstructed by the instanton knot concordance invariant $r_0$, we obstruct a non-alternating family of Montesinos knots, and we give prime alternating knots that are topologically but not smoothly biprojectively H-slice. We discuss why these knots remain plausible candidates for detecting exotic smooth structures on $\#^n\mathbb{CP}^2$ and suggest natural sources of further candidates.

analysis.workSummary: 构造有理 slice 但非 biprojectively H-slice 的无限结族，从8₁₈开始，回答有理结 concordance 中的相关问题。主要工具是对 signature 为零的结在多重 CP² 连通和中 H-sliceness 的格嵌入障碍；还处理既有 instanton 不变量 r₀ 未排除的2-bridge族、非交错 Montesinos 族及拓扑但非光滑 BPH-slice 的素交错结。
techniques: 有理 slice 与 H-slice 曲面
结 concordance 的光滑/拓扑区分
analysis.breakthrough: 证明有理 slice 性并不蕴含双射影 H-slice 性，并在既有障碍未检出的结族上增强检测能力。
analysis.limitations: 作为检测 CP² 连通和异乎通常光滑结构的候选仍是候选，摘要未构造或证明新的 exotic 光滑结构；格障碍的 signature 条件和背景定向须保留。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
